title: Withdraw reply
purpose: Withdraw a reply from client view, for example one posted on the wrong ticket. A supervisor does this, with a reason.
summary: Stop the client seeing a reply in the portal. Staff still see it, labelled as withdrawn, with your reason. Nothing is deleted. Supervisors only.

tasks.title: Withdraw a reply posted by mistake
steps: On the ticket, select [[Withdraw from client view]] under the reply.
Write the reason in [[Why withdraw this reply]] and select [[Withdraw from client view]].

tasks.title: Check that a reply was withdrawn
steps: Open the ticket and find the reply marked Reply, withdrawn from client view.
Under it, staff see who withdrew it, when and why.

good_to_know: Only a supervisor can withdraw a reply; the link is not shown to other roles and the server refuses them.
Withdrawing cannot be undone, and withdrawing twice is not possible. The reply stays on the ticket, labelled Reply, withdrawn from client view.
Only replies can be withdrawn. Notes and logged contacts are already internal.
The reason you give is shown to staff under the withdrawn reply, with your name and the time.

sections.title: Fields and actions
paragraphs: Opens from the link under a reply in the conversation, as a dialog or a full page. The page explains that the client stops seeing the reply, that staff keep seeing it with your reason and that nothing is deleted.
If the ticket changed after you opened this form, withdrawing is refused. Reload the ticket, check the reply is still the one to withdraw, and try again.

items.label: Why withdraw this reply
items.description: Required. Shown to staff under the withdrawn reply with who withdrew it and when, and kept in the audit history.

items.label: Withdraw from client view
items.description: Withdraws the reply and confirms Reply withdrawn from client view. Adds a timeline event, A reply was withdrawn from client view, and an audit event with your reason.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the ticket without changing anything.

items.label: Who may withdraw
items.description: Supervisors, including the admin role, for tickets they may read. Everyone else is refused.

items.label: Already withdrawn
items.description: Opening the page for a reply that is already withdrawn returns you to the ticket.

items.label: What the client sees
items.description: Clients see a reply that has not been withdrawn, and nothing else. After withdrawal the reply is no longer among them.

items.label: Closed tickets
items.description: A reply can still be withdrawn from a closed ticket.
